objectives: The key signatures for A, B♭ and E♭ major
How to tell a sharp key from a flat key at a glance
The order flats are written in

concept.title: Grade 2 key signatures
concept.body: A major has three sharps: F♯, C♯ and G♯. B♭ major has two flats, B♭ and E♭; E♭ major has three, B♭, E♭ and A♭. Flats are always written in the same order — B, E, A — each a fourth above the last.

teach.smartTip: In any flat key, the second-to-last flat names the key — B♭ major's flats are B♭, E♭ (so B♭); E♭ major's are B♭, E♭, A♭ (so E♭).
teach.didYouKnow: Flats are written in the order B, E, A, D, G, C, F — exactly the sharp order (F, C, G, D, A, E, B) reversed.
